name: FeatureShift
title: featureshift.com
shortDescription: FeatureShift helps businesses gather customer feedback, feature requests, and bug reports efficiently. It is designed for product managers and development teams to maintain a clear product roadmap and keep customers informed about updates. An example use case is a tech startup using FeatureShift to prioritize feature development based on user votes and feedback.
pros: No limitations on submissions or tracked users
cons: No clear integration with popular CRM tools
Limited customization options for larger enterprises
